Item No.1607 Court No.10

 Transfer Petition(s)(Civil) No(s).

962/2024
 Khambeswari Sahu 
 Versus
 Prasant Kumar Sahu Respondent(s)
 (For Admission and Ia No.83423/2024-STAY Application)
 Date : 10-04-2024
This petition was called on for hearing today.
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sandeep Mehta

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Shirish K. Deshpande, Aor
 Ms. Rucha Pravin Mandlik, Adv.
 Ms. Harsimran Kaur Rai, Adv.
 Mr. Mohit Gautam, Adv.
 Mr. Apoorv Sharma, Adv.

For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R
The petitioner-wife seeks transfer of the petition filed by the respondent-husband.

It is stated that the two proceedings initiated by the wife against the respondent being proceeding under the Protection of Women from Domestic Vilence Act, 2005 pending before Judicial Magistrate First Class Pune along with an FIR registered u/s 498A, 406 and 323 r/w 34 IPC bearing No.1260/2023 pending in Hinjewadi Police Station, Pune.
Issue notice, returnable in six weeks.
